project: OpenIslet.org (Project Islet-1) — Public Combinatorial Search Summary, Controlled Stepping-Stone Ladder & Edit-Budget Pareto Frontier
caveat: Prior-Anchored Scenario Outputs on a 0 to 1 comparative scale, NOT calibrated clinical survival probabilities. 97.17% of the score variance across the 2,160-combination grid comes from declared starting assumptions, 2.69% from assumption-evidence covariance, and 0.14% from empirical Ring-1/omics gene-signal deltas. Empirical head-to-head dish experiments in data/protocols/hip_core_fractional_factorial_v0.6.2.json are required to test whether intermediate 3-locus designs match or beat 4-locus Design A.

controlled_stepping_stone_ladder.label: Sana UP421 reference (naked, no switch)
controlled_stepping_stone_ladder.what_changed: B2M-/- + CIITA-/- + lentiviral CD47 in naked avascular clusters, no safety switch

controlled_stepping_stone_ladder.label: Minimal HIP + AAVS1 safety switch (naked)
controlled_stepping_stone_ladder.what_changed: Adds biallelic AAVS1-iCasp9 safety switch while keeping naked avascular clusters

controlled_stepping_stone_ladder.label: Minimal HIP + oxygen/vessel niche (no switch)
controlled_stepping_stone_ladder.what_changed: Places minimal HIP into <=120 um tri-hormonal clusters + microvessels + 72h CaO2/catalase without a safety switch

controlled_stepping_stone_ladder.label: Minimal HIP + oxygen/vessel niche + AAVS1 switch
controlled_stepping_stone_ladder.what_changed: Niche- and switch-matched minimal HIP peer: isolates the cell-engineering gap vs Design A on the exact same setting

controlled_stepping_stone_ladder.label: 3-locus B2M(HLA-E+CD47) + CIITA-KO + AAVS1 switch in niche
controlled_stepping_stone_ladder.what_changed: Pareto-best safety-switched 3-edit design: Design A without the CXCL10 SERPINB9/PD-L1 shield

controlled_stepping_stone_ladder.label: 5-locus minimal HIP + CXCL10(SERPINB9+PD-L1) + AAVS1 switch in niche
controlled_stepping_stone_ladder.what_changed: Pareto-best 5-edit design: minimal HIP plus the inducible CXCL10 shield (1 extra viral/locus edit vs Design A)

controlled_stepping_stone_ladder.label: Design A (4-locus lead)
controlled_stepping_stone_ladder.what_changed: Single-locus B2M(HLA-E+CD47) knock-in + CIITA-KO + CXCL10(SERPINB9+PD-L1) + biallelic AAVS1-iCasp9 in niche

controlled_stepping_stone_ladder.label: Design X (scored grid challenger)
controlled_stepping_stone_ladder.what_changed: Design A plus one INS leader/DRiP base edit on the shared baseline niche

controlled_stepping_stone_ladder.label: Design B (HLA-C-retained 6-locus + INS base-edit comparator)
controlled_stepping_stone_ladder.what_changed: HLA-A/B-KO retaining matched HLA-C + CIITA-KO + TYK2-KO + INS base edit + CXCL10 + AAVS1-iCasp9 in niche

stage0_head_to_head_protocol_pointer.summary: Two-stage bridged 36-run fractional-factorial dish protocol crossing X1 (minimal HIP vs Design A B2M knock-in), X2 (TYK2), X3 (none vs CXCL10 SERPINB9/PD-L1), X4 (INS edit), X5 (cluster/niche), and X6 (AAVS1 iCasp9).
